newsitem.title: CANADA: Finning sees Q2 close of Leverton purchase.
newsitem.headline: Finning sees Q2 close of Leverton purchase.

text.p: Finning Ltd, the world's largest dealer of Caterpillar Inc equipment, said on Friday it hopes to close its acquisitions of U.K.-based Leverton Ltd by the end of the second calendar quarter.
"I am hopeful we will have an announcement to make by the end of this quarter," Chief Executive Officer James Shepard told the annual shareholders's meeting.

Finning has been in negotiations for seven months to acquaire Leverton, which holds a Caterpillar franchis in Britain. The deal would make Finning the sole Caterpillar dis tributor in England, Scotland and Wales.
Shepard declined to provide details of the negotiations but said that the complexity of Leverton's operations was delaying negotiations.
The acquisition would add C$500 million to annual revenues. Finning, which has operations in Western Canada, Chile and Britain, had revenues of C$1.87 billion in 1996.
Shareholders at the meeting also voted to approve a two-for-one stock split, effective May 9, 1997.
They also approved a change in the company's name to Finning International Ltd, to reflect the company's growing focus outside Canada.
